For all the experiments, we use T5 models (T5-base and T5-3b) (Raffel et al., 2020) as the backbone models. For SISA, we follow Kumar et al. (2022) to split the dataset. For our unlearning layers, we only tune $0.5\%$ (Chen et al., 2023) of the parameters. The $\alpha = 0.8$ , $\lambda = 1.0$ and $\gamma = 0.2$ are selected from grid searching $\{0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 0.8, 1.0\}$ . We set the linear decay scheduler with a warmup ratio of 0.06 for training. The maximum sequence length is 128 for IMDB and 800 for SAMSum. The batch size was 256 for base models and 128 for 3b models on IMDB and 8 for base models and 2 for 3b models on SAMSum.
